item.title: Schools in Bentleigh Melbourne 2026: State, Private and School Zones
item.description:
Schools in Bentleigh: What Families Need to Know

Moving to Bentleigh with school-age children? Schools are the second thing you research after rent. In Melbourne, school zones drive real estate decisions as much as train lines and cafe strips. Understanding Bentleigh’s school landscape before you sign a lease saves you from the most common mistake: assuming access to a school your address does not zone you into.

State Primary Schools

Bentleigh is served by government primary schools within its zone boundaries. Enrolment is based on your residential address falling within the school’s designated neighbourhood boundary. You have a right to enrol at your designated neighbourhood school.

item.title: Bentleigh — History and How It's Changed
item.description:
Melbourne suburbs each carry their own history. The story of Bentleigh is a story of cultural diversity.

See our full Bentleigh suburb guide for the current picture.

What Bentleigh Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Bentleigh was agricultural land and market gardens. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.

Like most of Melbourne, Bentleigh’s history is inseparable from the broader story of a city that grew outward from the Yarra in waves. This suburb was settled when Melbourne needed it — whether for housing workers, accommodating families, or providing a retreat from the city centre.

Is Bentleigh Expensive?

Bentleigh sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Bentleigh, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.
